settings.headline: Accessibility statement
settings.subtitle: We want everyone to be able to use this fictional website.

settings.headline: Our commitment
settings.body:
This example site uses landmarks, a skip link, visible focus styles, labelled form controls and alt text on meaningful images. Templates are Liquid files you can edit, which makes accessibility fixes faster on a real deployment.

Conformance still has to be tested on your own site. If you find a barrier on this demo, it is part of the example, not a live patient service.
settings.side: Every Harlow Creek location in this story has step-free access. Ask any information desk for a wheelchair or a quiet waiting area.
